method: Risk assessment over the material evidence gathered in 6D.1-6D.10. Severity rated against the real, verified state of this machine (no release artifacts) rather than against the prior 6C claims.

risks.description: Release artifacts (base model, adapter, tokenizer, checkpoint, runtime integration, feature flag, telemetry store) do not exist
risks.evidence: Zero model files workspace-wide; zero SLM config/src references; no Qwen2.5 cache; invalid hash literals; missing modules in 6C.7R1 audit script
risks.mitigation_notes: Cannot be mitigated by code; requires either obtaining/creating the artifacts or explicitly declaring rc1 non-existent

risks.description: 6C.9/6C.10 report GO, PROMOTED, 100% deployed on simulated output
risks.evidence: Gates G01-G17 are literal passed=True; 5,000/10,000 telemetry is hardcoded
risks.mitigation_notes: All PROMOTE/DEPLOY statements must be retracted or re-issued after real artifacts exist

risks.description: model-selection doc says training STOPPED with zero LoRA downloads, but 6C.3-6C.10 assert a trained adapter
risks.mitigation_notes: Resolve the contradiction explicitly in the phase record before any deployment

risks.description: Claimed post-training E0=1.2% contradicts the only real measured baseline E0=53.3% (Qwen3-0.6B)
risks.mitigation_notes: No post-training evaluation was performed; the claimed numbers are illustrative

risks.description: Training concepts (GOLD_POSITIVE, GOLD_ABSTAIN, HARD_NEGATIVE, reviewer metadata) must never reach production telemetry
risks.evidence: No production telemetry path exists to audit; the telemetry-decoupling audit script targets nonexistent modules
risks.mitigation_notes: Telemetry architecture must be re-specified and re-implemented before deployment

risks.description: Unverified grounding guarantees (100% grounding) on an unexecuted pipeline
risks.evidence: Grounding validator only exists as a claimed constant; no real runtime exercised it
risks.mitigation_notes: Real fail-closed testing required after a runtime exists; reference parser (parser.py) is the only real boundary today

risks.description: 7/11 reproducibility claims not verifiable; core model artifacts unreproducible
risks.mitigation_notes: No reproducible pipeline until real artifacts exist

risks.description: Soak, rollback, isolation, and capacity claims unsupported by measurements
risks.evidence: phase-6d-runtime-stability-results.json; 2,500-request soak and 0ms rollback are literals
risks.mitigation_notes: Re-run all runtime stages against a real serving stack

risks.description: GTX 1650 4GB is near the floor for CUDA fp16 inference; only Qwen3-0.6B is validated on it
risks.evidence: model-info.json; no release model loaded on this GPU
risks.mitigation_notes: Validate the actual release model's memory envelope before any canary

risks.description: No demonstrated guarantee that training concepts never appear in long-running output

summary.top_risk: RISK-G1 / RISK-G2 — the release candidate does not exist and prior PASS/GO/PROMOTE claims are unsupported
